Sometime after the start of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the ''[[Far Orbit]]'' attempted to '''raid''' a [[Santhe/Sienar Technologies]] shipment, which was guarded by a [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]]. The crew of the ''Far Orbit'' aimed to capture the TIE with their ion weaponry, and add it to their [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] complement.<ref name="TFOP" />
